Version 0.2.1.
Developed by Dr. B. Issac Johny
Professor
Gnanam School of Business, Thanjavur

Start with the model summary and confidence intervals below. Requested interaction and
Johnson–Neyman diagrams follow these main tables.

charts.title: Interaction: x → m by w
charts.note: 95% pointwise confidence bands for fitted means. Conditional fitted means, not individual prediction intervals or total pathway effects. Other numerical predictors are held at complete-case means and categorical predictors at their declared reference.

charts.title: Johnson–Neyman: x → m across w
charts.note: 95% pointwise confidence band; no multiplicity adjustment. Green regions use analytic path-slope boundaries within the observed moderator range. This is a conditional path effect, not an indirect-effect region.
